'''Werner Kutzelnigg''' (September 10, 1933 – November 24, 2019 in [[Bochum]]) was a prominent Austrian-born [[theoretical chemistry|theoretical chemist]] and professor in the Chemistry Faculty, [[Ruhr-Universität Bochum]], [[Germany]].
Kutzelnigg was born in [[Vienna]]. His most significant contributions were in the following fields: [[relativistic quantum chemistry]], [[coupled cluster]] methods, theoretical calculation of [[NMR spectroscopy|NMR]] [[chemical shift]]s, explicitly correlated wavefunctions. He was a member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]].

== Life ==
Werner Kutzelnigg studied chemistry in Bonn and Freiburg i. Br. and was awarded his doctorate in 1960 for his experimental work "Untersuchungen zur Zuordnung der Normalschwingungen und Aufklärung der Struktur organischer Ionen".<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Werner Kutzelnigg|url=https://www.theochem.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/allcategories-en-gb/research/kutzelnigg/cv-kutzelnigg|access-date=2020-08-30|website=www.theochem.ruhr-uni-bochum.de}}</ref> He then turned to theoretical chemistry and became a postdoc with Bernard Pullman and Gaston Berthier in Paris from 1960 to 1963 and with Per-Olov Löwdin at Uppsala University from 1963 to 1964.<ref name=":0" /> In 1967 Kutzelnigg habilitated at the University of Göttingen under Werner A. Bingel.<ref name=":0" /> From 1970 to 1973 he was professor at the University of Karlsruhe and then full professor at the Chair of Theoretical Chemistry at the Ruhr University Bochum from 1972 until his retirement in 1998.<ref name=":0" />

Kutzelnigg has published papers on various topics in quantum chemistry: methods of treating electron correlation, magnetic properties of molecules (especially chemical shift), relativistic quantum chemistry, theory of chemical bonding and theory of intermolecular forces.<ref name=":0" />

Kutzelnigg also became known for his standard work Einführung in die theoretische Chemie.<ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==

* Carl-Duisberg-Gedächtnispreis (1971)<ref name=":0" />
* Schrödinger Medal of the World Association of Theoretical and Computational Chemists (1995)<ref name=":0" />
* Liebig-Denkmünze of the Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker (1996)<ref name=":0" />
* Erich-Hückel-Preis of the Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker (2016)<ref name=":0" />
* Member of the International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science<ref name=":0" />
